name: 91701 · Alta Loma, CA
findings: ZIP 91701 (Alta Loma) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91701 (Alta Loma) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91701 (Alta Loma) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
